episodes.synopsis: The Demon Lord did not return after 10 years just to face a pathetic shell of a man who once called himself a hero. This insult shall not stand!
episodes.title: The Demon Lord Returns!

episodes.synopsis: What exactly does a retired hero do all day? The Demon Lord is on the case! But Zenia isn’t thrilled her boss is still traipsing around the world of humans…
episodes.title: Beware the Glasses Girl

episodes.synopsis: Max and Leo are no ordinary travelers. That’s fitting because they meet Fred, who is no ordinary cleric either!
episodes.title: Fred the Cleric

episodes.synopsis: There’d be plenty of opportunities for Max if he joined the Demon Lord’s ranks: he could date monster girls and receive a generous benefits package! But does he want that?
episodes.title: The Hero’s New Challenge

episodes.synopsis: Max runs into an old acquaintance when he’s out shopping with the Demon Lord.
episodes.title: With His Grace!

episodes.synopsis: Max and the Demon Lord witness a battle between the Kingdom and the Republic. But just as the Kingdom gains the advantage, Leo arrives to save the day!
episodes.title: Border Tug-of-War

episodes.synopsis: Zenia infiltrates the Bureau of Magic on the Demon Lord’s orders. She fancies herself an expert spy but…
episodes.title: The Secretary Does Her Best

episodes.synopsis: Someone caused the explosion that rocked the Bureau of Magic, but the question is, who? Max and the Demon Lord certainly have a lot of explaining to do…
episodes.title: Farewell

episodes.synopsis: They were once allies, but now Fred and Leo find themselves on opposite sides as war brews between the Kingdom and the Republic.
episodes.title: A Hero Conflicted

episodes.synopsis: The last thing Max wants to do is get involved. But if he won't stop Fred and Leo from fighting, the Demon Lord will force him to.
episodes.title: Leo vs. Fred

episodes.synopsis: If Max wants to stop Fred and Leo, he'll need all the help he can get. Fortunately, an old friend prepared a backup.
episodes.title: The Hero, Covered in Mud

episodes.synopsis: Max was a fallen hero, but his actions have paved the way to peace and the public loves a good redemption story. What does the future hold this time?
episodes.title: The Fruits of Their Labor
